title: Porting Request Order
description: Order for porting request retrieved from administration api

firstPossibleDate.description: Date and time of the first possible date on which the porting can be performed

statusReason.description: Optional comment describing the reason for the current status of the porting request

errorDetails.description: Optional error details showing the details of why a porting request has been blocked automatically

documents.description: Documents associated with this porting request (LoA, Telco Invoice, etc.)

phoneNumber.description: The (first) phone number to be ported.

lastPhoneNumber.description: When a range of phone numbers are being ported, this number should be the last number in the range. If you are porting a single number, this value can be left empty.

ApiPortingRequest.title: Porting Request

phoneNumbers.description: Phone numbers to be ported over.

providerCompanyName.description: Company name of the current number provider.

preferredPortingDateTime.description: **Only used for porting non-dutch numbers.** Preferred date and time to port the phone number(s) in UTC time. Will be picked up between 6:00 and 20:00 UTC time. Should be null when the porting request should be handled as soon as possible.

companyProfileGuid.description: Unique identifier of the company profile that will be operating the ported numbers.

comment.description: Additional comment for customers to for example add a distribution group or IP address.

callbackUrl.description: URL that we'll send a POST request to when the status of the request has been updated. The body of this post request will contain the entire porting request order including the updated status.

ApiPortingRequest.description: A porting requests that allows you to port you phone numbers from your current provider to the CM.com platform.

ApiPortingRequestDocument.title: Porting Request Document

uploadedAt.description: Date and time when the document was uploaded

status.description: Current status of the document (Pending, Approved, Rejected)

approvedAt.description: Date and time when the document was approved (if applicable)

rejectionReason.description: Reason for rejection if the document was rejected

ApiPortingRequestDocument.description: Represents a document associated with a porting request

ApiPortingRequestOrderStatus.title: Porting Request Order Status
ApiPortingRequestOrderStatus.description: The status of a porting request
